model_name: BiOX apparent PFM response with DFT dielectric and elastic inputs

pfm.absolute_calibration: measured SSPFM d33_app is used as the response-level calibration target

direct_pressure.status: separate mechanical benchmark; not used to infer intrinsic piezoelectricity

mesh.warning: The reference block is a local PFM contact-patch proxy; morphology mode requires validated image measurements.

c3d_extension.warning: C^E and dielectric tensors are imported from the supplied VASP calculations. The only electromechanical coupling is an apparent e33 closure derived from measured SSPFM d33_app; it is not an intrinsic bulk tensor.

apparent_response_closure.interpretation: The COMSOL field/displacement map is a calibrated apparent-response comparison. Report d33_app and ranking as measurement-level observables; do not call e33_app an intrinsic coefficient.
apparent_response_closure.uncertainty: Propagate SSPFM standard deviation and DFT elastic uncertainty when available.
